ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution where high-intensity white pixels cover approximately 60-70% of the visible surface area, primarily on the distal lobes, contrasted against low-intensity black pixels concentrated in the central and peduncle-adjacent regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large, contiguous white geometric regions occupy the outer lobes. These are bordered by a central dark, wedge-shaped region. Extensive black pixel mottling and brush-like striations are mapped along the inner gradients where white and black regions meet.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute, symmetric V-shaped notch with an estimated interior angle of approximately 45-50 degrees and a deep vertical penetration into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular micro-topography. The right lobe trailing edge exhibits high-frequency serrations with prominent peaks, while the left lobe displays a smoother, lower-amplitude wave pattern with fewer sharp pixel-level oscillations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric upward concave sweep (scimitar-like) starting from the notch and extending to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct clusters of roughly circular, high-contrast white and beige pixel groups (barnacle attachments) localized at the extreme distal tips and along the leading edges of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible. Specifically, a series of three parallel diagonal marks on the mid-left lobe and several shorter, varied-angle marks on the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on the distal tips and significant linear scarring (rake marks) across the white ventral regions.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique cluster of small, isolated black focal spots (leucistic-like patterning) located in the mid-section of the left lobe white region.
